title: Aromatic Peppery French Sesame Bouillabaisse
description: A peppery and chewy French dish featuring sesame butter, this bouillabaisse is a shojin-friendly and energizing meal option, originating from the Lyon region of France.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced fennel and cook for 5 minutes, until it starts to soften.
Add the whole black peppercorns and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the vegetable broth, sesame butter, and saffron threads, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Stir in the chopped parsley and season with salt to taste.
Serve the bouillabaisse hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
